test_assertion_contracts: Checked look_at rejects collinear axes and returns finite transform for an orthogonal case.
Convenience look_at recovers coincident eye/target and collinear up, retaining eye and producing an orthonormal orientation.
Checked perspective verifies one FOV boundary and one near-plane boundary, valid finite output, metadata retention, and equal near/far rejection.
Checked affine inverse rejects singular and projective matrices and round-trips a simple translation.
proof_limits: Coverage gaps: no nonfinite eye/target/up cases; no aspect<=0, far<=near (other than equal), nonfinite inputs/results, or FOV endpoints; no perspective convenience clamp tests.
Coverage gaps: no affine nonfinite input/determinant/result, custom determinant threshold, or almost-but-not-exact affine row tests.
Tolerance rationale for 4*EPSILON is not stated; code alone does not establish why that bound was chosen, so no explanatory comment is proposed from inference.

test_assertion_contracts: try_new validation is covered for one nonfinite field and two negative fields, but not every field/value-class pairing.
Direction/quaternion constructors normalize valid nonunit inputs and reject selected zero/nonfinite inputs.
Configured threshold comparison uses squared norm and <= rejection.
ValidatedTransform normalizes quaternion and rejects zero scale under STRICT.
proof_limits: Coverage gap tied to ZCA-M001-001: no test deserializes NumericPolicy with invalid finite/negative threshold or then passes it to ValidatedTransform::try_new.
Other gaps: no negative normalized-length threshold case, positive scale/determinant floor rejection test, zero quaternion, nonfinite translation/scale, or negative scale admission case.

test_assertion_contracts: Valid current f32 scalar produces an exact receipt.
Nonfinite source is rejected before conversion.
proof_limits: Coverage gaps: no infinity, vector/matrix component propagation, viewport clamp, out-of-range, post-cast nonfinite, or receipt serde test.

Under current Real=f32 and RenderScalar=f32 aliases, every finite source is already representable in the destination type, so the test confirms an exact identity case rather than an actual precision narrowing; do not infer future f64 behavior.

test_assertion_contracts: Different-space point subtraction returns exact mismatch payload.
Zero normals and selected invalid deserialized checked types are rejected.
proof_limits: Coverage gaps: no Position3/Vector3/Normal3 serde roundtrip or invalid-wire check, vector+vector mismatch, point+vector mismatch, finite overflow, or valid nonzero Normal3 normalization assertion.
Serde rejection assertions establish only the selected UnitDirection3 and ValidatedTransform cases; they do not establish NumericPolicy Deserialize validation.

Tests establish only their written cases. Missing branch/serde cases and unexplained tolerance rationale do not justify invented annotations or product BUG labels.
